entities.name: Borg
entities.description: A pseudo-species of cybernetic humanoids from the Delta Quadrant who seek perfection through assimilation.

entities.name: Klingons
entities.description: An aggressive humanoid warrior race with a strict warrior code.

entities.name: Romulans
entities.description: A militaristic humanoid race, biological cousins of the Vulcans.

entities.name: Vulcans
entities.description: A stoic humanoid race defined by strict logic and emotional control.

entities.name: Surak
entities.description: An ancient teacher who founded the Vulcan philosophy.

entities.name: Q
entities.description: A species of nigh-omnipotent, immortal non-corporeal entities living in the Q Continuum.

entities.name: Q Continuum
entities.description: An alternate dimension accessible only to the Q and their invited guests.

entities.name: Gorn
entities.description: A bipedal reptilian species from the Beta Quadrant that hatches from parasitic eggs.

entities.name: Andorians
entities.description: A blue-skinned militaristic species and founding members of the United Federation of Planets.

entities.name: Tellarites
entities.description: A pig-like humanoid species whose homeworld founded the United Federation of Planets.

entities.name: Talosians
entities.description: A telepathic species who survive underground after a nuclear holocaust and experiment with humans.

entities.name: Vorta
entities.description: A species genetically engineered by the Founders of the Dominion.

entities.name: Xindi
entities.description: A group of six alien species that developed on the same planet.

entities.name: United Federation of Planets
entities.description: The interstellar union founded by species including the Andorians and Tellarites.

events.summary: The Romulans split from the Vulcans, descended from those who rejected Surak's reforms during the Time of Awakening.
events.quote: descended from those who rejected Surak 's reforms during the "Time of Awakening".

events.summary: A nuclear holocaust leaves the Talosian planet uninhabitable and kills most of the species; survivors move underground.
events.quote: a nuclear holocaust left their planet virtually uninhabitable and killed most of the species.

events.summary: A brutal civil war between the six Xindi species destroys their planet and leaves the Xindi-Avians believed extinct.
events.quote: as the result of a brutal civil war between the six species that destroyed the planet.
